user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Successful logout when logged-in user initiates logout
steps: User is redirected to the login page.
positive.expected_result: User successfully logs out and is presented with the login page.

negative.title: Logout fails when user is not logged in
steps: User attempts to click on the 'Logout' button.
negative.expected_result: User is shown a message indicating they must be logged in to log out.

edge.title: Logout while session is timing out
steps: User is inactive and session is about to timeout.
User clicks on the 'Logout' button just before the session times out.
edge.expected_result: User successfully logs out and is presented with the login page before session timeout occurs.
